intro.heading: Container storage in Sturry
intro.leadBefore: Brand-new steel vented containers on a gated, CCTV-covered yard. Dry, secure and yours to come and go from. Containers from
body: A 20ft container holds roughly a three-bed house's worth of furniture, or a full van-load of tools and stock. There's room to walk in and get at what you need, and you drive right up to the door and load straight in. Popular with builders keeping kit between jobs, traders holding stock overflow, and anyone clearing a house or garage.

A 40ft container is the bigger unit — for larger stock holdings, a full house clear-out, or whenever a 20ft isn't quite enough. Same brand-new, vented, drive-up setup, with plenty more floor space. Not sure which size you need? Give us a call and we'll help you work it out.
